correctness.rationale: The exact hyperbolic geometry was reconstructed. If the exterior point is at radius \(r+\varepsilon\), the right tangent triangle gives \(\cos\alpha=\tanh r/\tanh(r+\varepsilon)\) and \(\cos\gamma=\sinh r/\sinh(r+\varepsilon)\). Two right-triangle areas minus the disk sector yield exactly \(\delta(\varepsilon)=2\gamma-2\cosh r\,\alpha\). The square-root terms cancel; expanding through \(\varepsilon^{5/2}\) gives \(L_r=2\sqrt{2\tanh r}/3\) and \(M_r=-\sqrt2((\tanh r)^2+3)/(10\sqrt{\tanh r})\). Puiseux inversion yields the stated radius coefficients. Substituting into \(2\pi(\cosh(r+\varepsilon)-\cosh r)\) gives the displayed \(C_1,C_2\); direct algebra independently reproduces \(C_2=\pi3^{4/3}\cosh r((\tanh r)^2+8)/(20(\tanh r)^{2/3})\). The leading term agrees with the published illumination/floating-area theorem.
